summary: Charming Medical Limited, a BVI-incorporated Hong Kong-based healthcare services issuer listed in the US, filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement. The EGM is set for October 23, 2026 (Hong Kong time), seeking shareholder approval to cancel 15,000,000 authorized but unissued Class B ordinary shares, reduce authorized capital from 75,000,000 to 60,000,000 Class A shares, rename Class A shares as Shares, and adopt a third amended and restated memorandum and articles eliminating the dual-class structure. No Class B shares remain outstanding. The board recommends voting FOR all three proposals. This is a routine capital-structure housekeeping matter, not a special situation.
